# v6.3.0 — Series A Presentation Layer

This release marks completion of the Series A repository hardening pass for the Ouroboros runtime.

## Substrate (no behavioral change)

- 218/218 ouroboros runtime tests passing
- Receipt build p50 = 11.5 µs / p99 = 50.7 µs (62,764 ops/sec)
- Receipt verify p50 = 10.4 µs (74,149 ops/sec)
- Λ₉ base p50 = 3.12 µs / composed p50 = 3.29 µs
- 100% ρ-closure on 8,000 / 8,000 paired calls
- Platform v11: 24,800 HTTP calls, median Λ₁₀ overhead 0.49–0.59 ms/route, p99 ≤ 1.27 ms

## Added in this release

- **Apache-2.0 LICENSE** (replacing prior license declaration)
- **CITATION.cff** for software citation independent of the thesis
- **SECURITY.md** disclosure policy
- **CONTRIBUTING.md** + **CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md** (Contributor Covenant 2.1)
- **CODEOWNERS** + branch protection (admin-enforced, 1 review, code owner required)
- **OpenSSF Scorecard** workflow + badge (baseline 6.3–7.2)
- **CodeQL** for JavaScript/TypeScript + Python
- **Dependabot** for npm + GitHub Actions (weekly cadence)
- **TruffleHog** secret scan in CI
- **Reusable org workflows** SHA-pinned to `.github@c8359e5`
- **Mermaid runtime-architecture diagram** in README
- **Social preview banner** in `assets/`
- **pnpm 10** migration for monorepo consistency

## Reproducibility

- Companion thesis: [`szl-holdings/ouroboros-thesis`](https://github.com/szl-holdings/ouroboros-thesis) — concept DOI [`10.5281/zenodo.19944926`](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19944926)
- v11 paper DOI: [`10.5281/zenodo.20119582`](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20119582)
- Lean formalization of Λ uniqueness: [`szl-holdings/lutar-lean`](https://github.com/szl-holdings/lutar-lean)

## License & citation

Apache-2.0. To cite the runtime, use the `CITATION.cff` in the repository root or the DOI minted by Zenodo for this release.
